The view-file component I'm modifying takes a single file instead of an array, has no document navigation or zoom controls, and doesn't support QR fields.

Now I'm looking at what's missing compared to the bulk version: no signer dialog, no collision detection, no field filtering, simpler rendering without DPR handling, and some unused methods. The core difference is that bulk-pdf loads pre-processed files while this version handles raw File objects, so I need to port over the advanced features while keeping the single-document approach. I'm starting by adding the loading overlay, QR button, and updated instructions while maintaining the simpler file loading pattern. Writing the Vue component... Writing component markup... Setting up computed properties for filtering fields by page, checking for QR field types, and managing a dual-state property that syncs full name and document info settings together. Then I'm adding a watcher on the file input to handle PDF loading.

Continuing with watchers...

I'm setting up the PDF loading logic to read the file as an array buffer, then using pdf.js to parse it and extract the page count so I can render individual pages on demand.

Now I need to handle the rendering process itself—if there's already a render in progress, I'll cancel it first, then grab the canvas and container references, validate that the PDF is loaded properly, and fetch the page data along with its original dimensions.

Setting up the viewport and scale calculations...

Now I'm waiting for the render task to complete, then updating the canvas dimensions in the next tick and handling any rendering errors. After that, I'm implementing the zoom controls to adjust the scale and re-render the page accordingly.

Moving on to navigation, I'm adding methods to move between pages while checking that rendering isn't already in progress. Then I'm building out the signature field creation logic, which generates a unique ID, pulls from available IDs if they exist, and constructs a new field object with positioning and naming conventions.

Adding QR field functionality... I'm setting up the duplicate dialog by storing the selected field and current page, then when confirmed, I'm creating a new field with fresh IDs and slightly offset positioning to avoid overlap.

Now I'm implementing collision detection to check if two rectangles overlap, then setting up the drag functionality by capturing the initial mouse position and calculating the offset relative to the PDF container's position.

Still writing drag logic... Writing drag and resize handlers... Continuing to constrain the resize dimensions based on whether the field contains data, then clamping the new width and height to their min/max bounds, and checking for collisions with other fields on the canvas. Writing component styles... Still writing styles... Still writing styles...

Now I'm reconsidering how the `loadPDF` function handles the file prop—it's typed as either a string or ArrayBuffer, but the current implementation uses `FileReader.readAsArrayBuffer()` which only works with Blob or File objects. I should keep the existing loading approach but make sure it's consistent with how the single PDF component handles files. I need to handle both cases—if the file is already an ArrayBuffer, use it directly, otherwise use FileReader to convert the Blob/File. I'll stick with the FileReader approach since it's working in production, and just modernize it to use promises.

content.text:
El archivo `bulk-pdf/view-file.vue` ha sido actualizado. Aquí un resumen de los cambios realizados:

**Funcionalidades agregadas desde single-pdf:**
- **Overlay de carga** (`isRendering || loadingPDF`) con spinner y mensaje
- **Botón de código QR** con `addQrField` y computed `hasQrField`
- **Controles de zoom** (`zoomIn`/`zoomOut`) con porcentaje visible
- **Diálogo de datos del firmante** (`signerDataDialog`) con checkboxes para nombre completo y documento
- **Detección de colisiones** (`checkCollision`) en drag y resize
- **Límites de arrastre** (los campos no pueden salir del PDF)
- **`instanceId`** en cada campo para identificación única
- **`includeFullName` / `includeDocumentInfo`** en campos de firma
- **`enforceMinDataSize`** al activar datos del firmante
- **Renderizado mejorado** con DPR (devicePixelRatio), cancelación de render anterior, y manejo de `currentScale` vs `originalPdfWidth/Height`
- **`pdf-wrapper`** div para posicionamiento correcto de campos
- **Instrucciones completas** (5 puntos en vez de 3)
- **`filteredFields`** computed que filtra por página actual

**Adaptaciones al contexto bulk (documento único):**
- Se mantiene el prop `file` (Blob) en lugar de `files` (Array)
- Sin navegación entre documentos (solo páginas)
- `currentPage` sigue siendo un número simple
- El emit `update-fields` mantiene la firma original (solo `newFields`, sin `fileId`)
- Los campos no incluyen `fileId` ya que es un solo documento

**Código eliminado:**
- Método `duplicateField` duplicado/no usado
- Método `updateFieldPositions` de debug
- Estilos CSS duplicados
